verdict.rationale: Ramp documents in-product AI ('Ramp Intelligence') that produces suggestions from the user's own data: AI-filled memos and categories, auto-categorization learned from history and team feedback, and real-time anomaly and fraud flagging. However, the documented analytical insights (spend trends, forecasting) are delivered through Ramp MCP inside external assistants like Claude or ChatGPT, not inside the Ramp product itself. That leaves only the suggestion half of the story clearly evidenced in-product. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or analytics (spend trends, forecasting, recommendations) surfaced within Ramp's own UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product AI suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
